_comment: Golden expectations for the fee engine. Derived by hand from RULES.md (the contract) and the fictional fixtures schedules.json / scenarios.json by two independent derivers, then reconciled scenario by scenario; NOT derived from the engine code. Keys starting with an underscore are metadata (_working explains each scenario). Money in E4 = integer ten-thousandths of a dollar; allocation figures are decimal strings. Where RULES.md is silent and both derivers made the same call, the call is recorded here: (1) packaging_unmatched is only raised when the schedule has at least one packaging-conditioned rule (lines, tiers and rounding_* have none, so a typed or untyped package raises nothing there); (2) an order line's quantity is the chargeable quantity c (after the free allowance), the packages the rule won for package rules, and the base in dollars (4 dp) for percent lines; a null distinctSkus gives reason skus_unknown by analogy with A1; (3) a schedule with no minimum rule gives minimums [] which is treated as exact with a top-up of 0, so allocation.monthly.minimumTopUp is '0.00' (not null); (4) allocation annual = exact (unrounded) monthly total x 12 rounded once, which only matters in tiers_monthly_storage (365608.93, not 30467.41 x 12 = 365608.92); (5) quantity strings of non-terminating decimals are given to 20 significant digits (see _disagreements).

_disagreements.decision: Representation only, not a value difference. 40 x 30.4375 / 7 = 173.928571428571428571... repeats forever; deriver 1 rounded at 20 decimal places, deriver 2 at 20 significant digits, and both are correct roundings of the same number. RULES.md B2 fixes the AMOUNT (HALF_UP to E4 once, from the unrounded product: 217.4107142857... = 2174107, monthly total 4674107; both derivers agree on these) but gives no precision for a non-terminating quantity string. Kept 20 significant digits (173.92857142857142857). The golden test should compare this one quantity numerically (for example within 1e-12) rather than as a string; amountE4 and every other field are exact.

Unresolved ordered by position (pack_other 5, inserts 6). definite 38500.
